slides.texte_overlay:
How to stop feeling
jealous of other men
Notice that you only see their highlights. Their new car, their promotion, their holiday. You don't see their debts, doubts or bad nights.
Turn jealousy into information. What exactly do you envy? Fitness, money, confidence? It tells you what you really want to work on.
Compete only with yourself. Compare this year's you with last year's you. That's the only race that is fair and actually matters.
Celebrate other men's wins out loud. Congratulating someone sincerely kills jealousy fast and makes you the kind of man people respect.
Before: I compared myself to everyone online. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I focus on my own growth now.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I compared myself to everyone online. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I focus on my own growth now.

slides.texte_overlay: Use less social media. Fewer hours scrolling through other people's lives means fewer reasons to feel behind. Mute the accounts that make you feel small.
Be grateful for what you have. Health, friends, a roof, a skill. Writing three things down each night slowly changes how you see your life.
